Data Analyst - Product & Marketing
BookMyShow
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (On-site)

About the Role:
We are seeking an energetic Data Analyst to evaluate customer journeys, campaign performance, and product features across our entertainment ticketing platform.

Responsibilities:
• Extract, transform, and analyze large datasets using SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy).
• Build and maintain automated executive dashboards in Tableau or PowerBI.
• Partner with product management on A/B testing design, sample sizing, and statistical significance.
• Identify user churn patterns and recommend lifecycle marketing initiatives.

Requirements:
• 1-3 years of work experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or product analytics.
• Expert proficiency in SQL and Python.
• Strong understanding of A/B testing, cohort analysis, and funnel metrics.
• Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related discipline.
